self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Busybody's Running Light: using an Elemental Skill increases ATK by 40% for 10s. Movement SPD bonus not modeled (non-combat).

en.flavor: Once upon a time, there was a youkai that roamed Inazuma in the form of a lantern's flame. This must once have been one of its vessels.

refinements.1: Increase ATK by <r>20%</r> and Movement SPD by 10% for 10s when using an Elemental Skill.
refinements.2: Increase ATK by <r>25%</r> and Movement SPD by 10% for 10s when using an Elemental Skill.
refinements.3: Increase ATK by <r>30%</r> and Movement SPD by 10% for 10s when using an Elemental Skill.
refinements.4: Increase ATK by <r>35%</r> and Movement SPD by 10% for 10s when using an Elemental Skill.
refinements.5: Increase ATK by <r>40%</r> and Movement SPD by 10% for 10s when using an Elemental Skill.

fr.flavor: Il était une fois, un démon qui parcourait Inazuma sous la forme d'une flamme de lanterne en papier. Cela devait être l'un de ses vaisseaux.
